title: Unannotated Switch Fallthrough
pattern: Allowing execution in a switch statement to slide from one case block directly into the next without explicit annotation.
why_bad: High-risk maintenance hazard. A subsequent modifier can easily cause bugs or break logic when reordering or modifying cases.
detection: A switch case block that does not terminate with `break`, `return`, `throw`, or an explicit compiler fallthrough attribute.
counterexample: Cases stacked directly on top of each other with no code in between (shared case blocks).
